config.prosperity.title: Prosperity Configuration
config.prosperity.server_locked_note: §7These settings are controlled by the server operator. They are shown read-only with the server's current values; edit them from the server's config or with §f/prosperity reload§7. HUD settings below stay yours to change.
config.prosperity.enableInstancedLoot.to: Give each player their own private loot from naturally-generated containers. Disable to fall back to vanilla shared loot.
config.prosperity.enableVisualIndicators: Show a gold sparkle above containers you have not yet looted.
config.prosperity.indicatorRenderDistanc: Maximum distance, in blocks, at which unlooted indicators render. Fades out over the final 8 blocks.
Distance, in blocks, within which indicators render through walls. Beyond this they are occluded by terrain.
Scale loot quality and stack sizes with distance from world origin.
config.prosperity.endAlwaysMaxTier.toolt: Treat the End dimension as the highest distance tier regardless of coordinates.
config.prosperity.distanceTiers.tooltip: One tier per row as: name, minDistance, stackMultiplier, qualityModifier (e.g. wilderness, 3000, 2.0, 2). Malformed rows are dropped on save.
config.prosperity.structureOverrides.too: One override per row as: structure, mode, tier (e.g. minecraft:monument, fixed, wilderness). Mode is fixed, minimum, or maximum. Malformed rows are dropped on save.
config.prosperity.enableLootInjection.to: Allow datapacks to additively inject extra entries into instanced loot.
config.prosperity.enableStructureComplet: Grant one extra injected reward, once per structure per player, for looting every instanced container in a multi-container structure.
config.prosperity.lootTableBlacklist.too: Loot table ids that stay vanilla (not instanced), one per row (e.g. minecraft:chests/spawn_bonus_chest).
config.prosperity.enableLootNotification: Show an action-bar message with tier and structure when you first open an instanced container.
config.prosperity.enableLootRefresh.tool: Let instanced containers regenerate their loot after a cooldown.
config.prosperity.lootRefreshDays.toolti: In-game days before a looted container can refresh, when refresh is enabled.
config.prosperity.randomizeLootOnRefresh: When a container refreshes, roll fresh loot instead of repeating the same items it held before.
Drop a player's stored container data once they have been offline past the eviction threshold. Their uncollected loot is forfeit; if they return, containers regenerate fresh for them.
config.prosperity.absentPlayerEvictionDa: In-game days a player must be gone before their stored container data is evicted, when eviction is enabled.
config.prosperity.enableContainerProtect: Slow down breaking of unlooted instanced containers.
config.prosperity.protectionBreakMultipl: How much slower an unlooted instanced container is to break (1.0 = vanilla speed).
When container protection is on, make a container with unclaimed loot fully unbreakable in survival (and immune to explosions) instead of just slower. Creative players still break it.
config.prosperity.enableMobLootScaling.t: Apply distance-tier scaling to mob drops as well as containers.
config.prosperity.enableFishingLootScali: Apply distance-tier scaling to fishing catches, biasing toward treasure at higher tiers.
config.prosperity.enableTrialChamberScal: Scale trial chamber vault loot and trial spawner rewards by the chamber's distance tier.
config.prosperity.partyLootMode.tooltip: Players on the same scoreboard team share one loot instance per container instead of each getting their own. Teamless players still get individual instances.
Minutes a player who just left a team keeps generating new shared instances against their former team's key (0 = off). Only applies while Party Loot Mode is on.
config.prosperity.showIndicators.tooltip: Client toggle for rendering unlooted-container sparkles, independent of the server setting.
config.prosperity.enableTierHud.tooltip: Show the distance-tier badge on the HUD.
config.prosperity.hudAnchor.tooltip: Screen corner the tier HUD badge anchors to.
config.prosperity.hudOffsetX.tooltip: Horizontal offset, in pixels, of the tier HUD badge from its anchor corner.
config.prosperity.hudOffsetY.tooltip: Vertical offset, in pixels, of the tier HUD badge from its anchor corner.
